summary: Completed testing for Patient Appointment Dates feature (Last Clinic Appointment and Records Appointment VSP fields). All 10 backend tests and 11 frontend tests passed. The new date fields are visible in the Patient expanded detail view, editable via date inputs, and save on blur via PATCH /api/patients/{mrn}/appointment-dates endpoint. Activity log correctly records date changes.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing patients. Andrew Burton (MRN: 6011054) has dates set: last_clinic_appointment=2026-04-01, records_appointment=2026-04-05. Friedderich Will (MRN: 602343) has records_appointment=2026-05-10 set during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Patient Appointment Dates feature fully implemented and tested. Two new date-only fields added to Patient model: last_clinic_appointment and records_appointment. Fields appear in Patient Details section of expanded patient view on Patients tab. Date inputs use HTML date type and save on blur via PATCH /api/patients/{mrn}/appointment-dates endpoint. Activity log records all date changes with format 'Last Clinic Appt: old → new' or 'Records Appt: old → new'. Backend endpoint handles null values for clearing dates and returns 'No changes' message when values unchanged.
